create.name: Festival of Faiths
create.bio:
The Festival of Faiths is a yearly interfaith gathering in Louisville, Kentucky, organised by the city's Center for Interfaith Relations; its thirtieth edition takes place in November 2026 at the Kentucky Center for the Performing Arts. Over several days it brings together teachers and scholars from Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, Indigenous and other traditions for conversations, workshops, music, poetry and film, built each year around a shared theme such as love, belonging or sacred courage.

The festival's YouTube channel, running since 2013, keeps recordings of its talks and sessions. Alongside keynote conversations there are hour-long spiritual practice sessions led from inside particular traditions, such as Buddhist teaching on the four immeasurables, Christian chant, Hindu yoga and Jewish practice, and talks by figures including Thupten Jinpa, Anam Thubten, Judith Simmer-Brown, Omid Safi, Anantanand Rambachan and Lynne Twist. Recent uploads lean towards short clips, with full sessions from each year's programme following later.
